metaTitle: Clinic Website Design India | Live in 48 Hours
metaDescription: Trust-first clinic websites that rank on Google and capture appointments. Designed, engineered and live in as little as 48 hours. From ₹7,999.
headline: Your next patient is searching right now. *Be the clinic they find.*
sub: SiteBlitz builds trust-first websites for clinics and doctors — pages that rank for the conditions you treat and turn late-night searches into booked appointments.

painPoints.title: Invisible where it matters
painPoints.text: Most clinic sites are one generic homepage. No pages for the services you offer or the conditions you treat — so when a patient searches for exactly what you do, Google shows someone else.

painPoints.title: No way to book
painPoints.text: A phone number in the footer is not appointment capture. Patients search after hours, decide after hours, and move on to the clinic that let them request a slot at 11pm.

painPoints.title: Design that erodes trust
painPoints.text: Healthcare is a trust decision. A dated template with stock photos, no doctor profiles and no timings makes patients hesitate — and a hesitating patient calls the clinic next door.

mustHaves.title: Trust-first design
mustHaves.text: Doctor profiles with credentials, real clinic photography, clean layouts that feel as professional as your practice. Patients should feel reassured before they ever walk in.

mustHaves.title: Appointment capture that never sleeps
mustHaves.text: Lead forms plus WhatsApp integration on every page. A patient can request an appointment at midnight and your front desk sees it first thing in the morning.

mustHaves.title: Service and condition pages that rank
mustHaves.text: One page per treatment, per condition, per question patients actually search. Server-rendered SEO and structured data on every build, so Google reads your site the way patients do.

mustHaves.title: Patient FAQs that pre-answer the phone call
mustHaves.text: Consultation fees, what to bring, insurance, recovery times. Answer them on the page and your front desk stops repeating itself — and patients arrive already convinced.

mustHaves.title: Timings, directions and speed
mustHaves.text: Opening hours and a tap-to-navigate map, front and centre. Built to 90+ Lighthouse targets so the site loads fast on the mobile connection your patients actually use.

faqs.q: How fast can my clinic website go live?
faqs.a: A one-page site on the Launch package (₹7,999, one page, delivered in 2 working days once your content is ready). Need separate pages for services and doctors? The Business package (₹17,999) covers three pages in 7 working days once ready; more pages are quoted.

faqs.q: Will patients actually find us on Google?
faqs.a: That is the point of the build. Every site ships with server-rendered SEO and structured data. Ranking positions take time and nobody honest can promise them — what we control is a foundation Google can read completely.

faqs.q: How will we know the website is working?
faqs.a: Growth and Scale plans include a first-party analytics dashboard — visitors, sources and enquiry funnels, in plain language. No guesswork. We publish our own live numbers at /proof, and you get the same visibility.

cta: Get your clinic online in 48 hours
